digest.component_or_area: LLM review sidecar retention and pruning
propositions: Plan-review sidecar retention bound RETAIN_PER_TICKET must be raised from 10 to 50 to preserve audit history across multi-round remediation loops.
Code-review sidecar currently lacks pruning logic and allows REVIEW_RESULT events to grow unbounded on the tickets branch.
Both plan-review and code-review sidecars must be governed by a single shared RETAIN_PER_TICKET constant to ensure consistent retention behavior across paths.
Code-review sidecar emit() must call a prune() function after appending events, mirroring plan-review's emit-then-prune sequence.
After 50+ review events on a single ticket, exactly 50 REVIEW_RESULT sidecars are retained (newest-first) and older events are removed via git rm.
